newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble lower in quiet pre-weekend trade.
newsitem.headline: Rouble lower in quiet pre-weekend trade.

text.p: The rouble eased on plentiful supply and dealers said on Friday trading was quiet ahead of the weekend.
"The supply of roubles is sufficient. Some money may have gone to the Treasury bill market but it did not affect the liquidity of this market," said Vozrozhdenye Bank chief dealer Maxim Poltavets.

Roubles for today settlement were quoted at 5,487-89 per dollar compared with an early 5,483-85 and 5,478-80 late on Thursday. Tomorrow roubles eased to 5,487-89 per dollar from yesterday's late 5,483-86.
The central bank said it had set 5,479/5,489 as its bid and offer rates against the dollar on Friday.
Overnight rouble credits yielded 5-10 percent compared with Thursday's late 50-65 percent.
